new_libraries.sentence: A lightweight library for serial-port interaction: send commands and get/set sketch variables via a JSON- and Python-compatible text interface.
new_libraries.paragraph:
In one line, and usually with less than a microsecond of overhead, keyhole.variable("foo", foo); provides serial-port access to an integer, floating-point or String variable in your sketch. Set its value by sending foo=123
 - the variable() method will return true to let the sketch know when you do this. Query it by sending foo
 . Query all exposed variables at once by sending ?
 , or choose to have them auto-report themselves periodically. Responses are in easy-to-parse JSON format and can be turned into Python dicts with one call to ast.literal_eval(), but there's a plotter-compatibility mode too. For the computer's side of the interaction, a complementary Python module is included in the project repository (or available separately from PyPI with python -m pip install keyhole-comm[serial] ).

new_libraries.name: MQTT Client
new_libraries.author: Andreas Motzek <andreas-motzek@t-online.de>
new_libraries.sentence: MQTT Client lets you connect to a MQTT broker and publish strings to a topic.
new_libraries.paragraph: First create a MQTTClient. You have to pass a task list from Cooperative Multitasking, a client (e.g. WiFiClient from WiFi101), host, port and credentials of the MQTT broker. Then create a MQTTTopic. Use the MQTTClient and the topic name as arguments when doing that. To connect to the broker call MQTTClient::connect(). After that you can call MQTTTopic:publish("...") to publish a string. Requires Cooperative Multitasking for processing the acknowledgement packets of the broker. So you have call CooperativeMultitasking::run() in your loop() function. See the examples for details.

new_libraries.name: RL_ToneSongPlayer

new_libraries.sentence: Arduino library to play songs composed of tone notes and durations on a digital pin in a non-interrupting way without using the delay() function.

new_libraries.name: RoboLink
new_libraries.author: Sakib Ahmed Shanto

new_libraries.name: RoboServo
new_libraries.author: dunknowcoding
new_libraries.sentence: A high-performance servo control library for ESP32 family and ESP8266 with multi-servo support.

Features include support for 180/270/360 degree servos, grouped servo control with synchronized PWM, configurable rotation ranges and frequencies (40-400Hz), automatic GPIO validation per variant, optimized PWM generation with intelligent channel management, and safe coexistence with analogWrite().

new_libraries.name: RotaryEncoderPoll_CW

new_libraries.name: RPL

new_libraries.paragraph: RPL is designed for embedded systems communication, featuring zero-copy, high-efficiency packet parsing with built-in CRC validation.

new_libraries.name: RTC3231

new_libraries.paragraph: Including temperature, alarms and memory storage if present. Includes DateTime class implementation and its conversion.

new_libraries.name: SAM32WiFiEsp

new_libraries.paragraph: Arduino WiFi library for ESP8266. Works only with SDK version 1.1.1 and above (AT version 0.25 and above). Compatible with Arduino 101 and other SAM32-based controllers.

new_libraries.name: SavaButton
new_libraries.author: SavaLab
new_libraries.sentence: Расширенная библиотека кнопок с программным отключением, длительным нажатием, двойным щелчком и прогрессивной поддержкой автоматического повтора.
new_libraries.paragraph: Эффективно работает с цифровыми входами благодаря автоматическому подавлению отскока контактов. Поддерживает режимы ввода "ПЛЮС" (внутреннее подтягивание) и "МИНУС" (внутреннее опускание). Имеет надежную систему событий для обнаружения щелчка, длительного нажатия, двойного щелчка и автоматического повтора (простого и последовательного). Глобальное время отключения для оптимизации использования памяти.

new_libraries.name: SavaLED_ESP32
new_libraries.author: SavaLab
new_libraries.sentence: Высокопроизводительная, неблокирующая библиотека WS2812/SK6812 для ESP32 со встроенными эффектами.
new_libraries.paragraph: Мощная и эффективная библиотека для управления адресуемыми светодиодами (WS2812/SK6812) на ESP32 с помощью периферийного устройства RMT. Он имеет полностью неблокирующую архитектуру, которая не останавливает цикл (), что идеально подходит для проектов с задачами реального времени, такими как обработка звука или создание сетей. Включает вспомогательные функции для легкой настройки цвета (RGB / HSV), гамма-коррекцию для улучшения качества изображения и расширенные встроенные эффекты, такие как "Кометы".

new_libraries.name: SavaOLED_ESP32
new_libraries.author: SavaLAB
new_libraries.sentence: Быстрая и легкая OLED-библиотека I2S на базе фреймбуфера для ESP32.
new_libraries.paragraph: Эта библиотека предназначена для работы с высокоскоростной графикой на дисплеях SSD1306 (128x64) с использованием интерфейса I2S ESP32. Она использует полный буфер кадров для обновления без мерцания и оптимизирована для повышения производительности.

new_libraries.name: SavaTime
new_libraries.author: SavaLab
new_libraries.sentence: Неблокирующие программные таймеры и блоки промышленной автоматизации (TON, TOF, Pulse, Gen).
new_libraries.paragraph: Обширная библиотека синхронизации на основе миллисекунд () и микросекунд (). Логика, подобная логике ПЛК: TON (задержка включения), TOF (задержка выключения с повторным запуском), задержка импульса (по времени) и генераторы (Gen, Multi, AsMulti). Все функции поддерживают прямое включение входных сигналов, устраняя необходимость в сложных структурах if/else. Включает функцию Reset() для обеспечения безопасности в сложных автоматах состояний.

new_libraries.name: SavaTrig
new_libraries.author: SavaLab
new_libraries.sentence: Библиотека логических триггеров (R_TRIG, F_TRIG, T_TRIG, RS, SR) для автоматизации.
new_libraries.paragraph: Эффективная реализация стандартов IEC 61131-3 для Arduino. Включает детекторы фронтов (Rising/Falling), переключатели (Toggle) и триггеры с приоритетами (Set/Reset Dominant). Оптимизирована по памяти (использует битовые маски).

new_libraries.name: Sbutton

new_libraries.name: SimpleMeteoCalc

This library evolved from use of Arduinos in escape room setups, which required many Arduinos to be centrally controlled and monitored.

new_libraries.name: SmoothAxis

Includes built-in support for dead zones and sticky endpoints. See the repository for algorithm details.

new_libraries.name: SMoS

new_libraries.paragraph: SMoS is a client/server REST based messaging protocol, originally intended as a mechanism to encapsulate data and its context when transmitted over a serial link.

new_libraries.name: SnappyXO-PreciseMovement-library

new_libraries.name: solar2lunar

new_libraries.name: StarterRemote

If you want to know more about the project or report bugs, etc. please visit the project page at: https://gitlab.com/robostarter.

new_libraries.name: StateMachineFramework
new_libraries.author: Anatoli Arkhipenko <arkhipenko@hotmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Lightweight table-driven state machine framework built on TaskScheduler.
new_libraries.paragraph: Provides cooperative multitasking state machines with three core abstractions: smAction (state behavior with onEnter/onRun/onExit lifecycle), smState (action wrapper with TaskScheduler integration), and smMachine (transition orchestrator using table-driven {fromState, exitCode, toState} transitions). Supports device abstraction via smDevice interface, configurable execution intervals, and standard exit codes for common conditions.

new_libraries.name: steamrocket

new_libraries.name: StensTimer

new_libraries.name: STools

new_libraries.name: SyncGenie
new_libraries.author: Jeremy Hill <jezhill@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: A library for interfacing with a Teensy development board via the SyncGenie breakout board, including tools for various neuroscience synchronization and triggering purposes.
new_libraries.paragraph: The library provides high-level classes with names like `Trigger`, `TriggerDC`, `Switch`, `Wheel` and `Gauge`, that wrap up common event-detection and de-bouncing logic efficiently, and in a way that users can adapt easily by manipulating a few parameters. The library also provides a framework that simplifies the construction of user menus to be displayed on the SyncGenie's LCD screen, as well as utilities for saving settings to (and loading them back from) persistent storage. The code is not architecture-specific although it does include the pinout for the SyncGenie, which is a Teensy-specific open-hardware device (more details at https://osf.io/r9pb6 ).

new_libraries.name: SynoLinks

This library provides easy MQTT connectivity for Arduino, ESP32, ESP8266, and other WiFi-capable boards. Features virtual pins, batch data, OTA firmware updates, and auto-reconnect.

new_libraries.name: TinyGPSPlusPlus

new_libraries.name: TinyIO

The library includes implementations for digital and analog inputs and outputs, making it suitable for a wide range of projects.

new_libraries.name: TinyScheduler

Whether you need to run a task after a delay, repeat an action periodically, or execute a function multiple times with custom intervals, this library provides an easy-to-use interface. Built with flexibility in mind, the library supports passing functions, lambdas, or callable objects, giving you full control over scheduling behaviors.

new_libraries.paragraph: The library supports both the I2C (via the Wire Library) interface. Use of other I2C libraries (e.g. software I2C) is supported by inheritance.

new_libraries.name: uFire PAR Sensor
new_libraries.author: uFire
new_libraries.sentence: Measure photosynthetically active radiation (PAR).
new_libraries.paragraph: An I2C sensor to measure PAR in μmol/m²/s.

new_libraries.name: Ulm_Weatherballoon
new_libraries.author: Falko Schmidt
new_libraries.sentence: Library for high altitude applications.
new_libraries.paragraph: This software is designed for high-altitude weather balloons, enabling them to reach the edge of space and collect data from the stratosphere. However, please note that not all implementations have been fully tested in actual flight conditions.

new_libraries.name: UltraDistSensor
new_libraries.author: Shubham Trivedi
new_libraries.sentence: Interface the HC-SR04 sensor and ping sensor to Arduino.
new_libraries.paragraph: The UltraDistSensor library has been developed to allow HC-SR04 sensor and ping sensor to communication with arduino board. This library can be used to interface multiple sensors.

new_libraries.name: unPhoneLibrary
new_libraries.author: Hamish Cunningham, Gareth Coleman, Jon Williamson, Mary Hewitt, others
new_libraries.sentence: An Arduino library for the unPhone.
new_libraries.paragraph: The unPhone is an open Internet of Things electronics platform for educationalists, makers and developers based on the ESP32 and ESP32S3. The device makes rapid prototyping of IoT systems easy by providing pre-integrated UI, PMU, accelerometer, LoRa radio and etc., with an expansion capability conforming to Adafruit’s FeatherWing standard. Extensive documentation at https://iot.unphone.net and integration with the Arduino, Espressif and PlatformIO open source communities make getting up and running fast and lightweight.

new_libraries.name: USBSnifferPIO_RP2040
new_libraries.author: Ângelo Moisés Alves
new_libraries.sentence: Passive USB 1.1 packet sniffer using the RP2040 PIO coprocessor.
new_libraries.paragraph: Captures Low-Speed (1.5 Mbps) and Full-Speed (12 Mbps) USB packets passively through high-impedance GPIO tapping. Uses a single PIO state machine for deterministic 8x oversampled line sampling, DMA ping-pong buffering for zero-copy data transfer, and a full software decoder implementing clock recovery, NRZI decoding, bit-unstuffing, packet framing, and CRC5/CRC16 verification. Delivers structured USBPacket objects through a callback API. Dual-core ready. Ideal for protocol analysis, HID device monitoring, and USB debugging.

new_libraries.name: VEGA_ArduinoBLE
new_libraries.author: CDAC
new_libraries.sentence: Enables Bluetooth® Low Energy connectivity on the VEGA ARIES Boards, Arduino MKR WiFi 1010, Arduino UNO WiFi Rev.2, Arduino Nano 33 IoT, Arduino Nano 33 BLE, Nicla Sense ME and UNO R4 WiFi.
new_libraries.paragraph: This library supports creating a Bluetooth® Low Energy peripheral & central mode.

new_libraries.name: VEGA_BMI088

new_libraries.paragraph: This library supports SPI communication with the BMI088

new_libraries.paragraph: Arduino library to control Grove - Chainable RGB LED.

new_libraries.name: VEGA_FirebaseArduino
new_libraries.author: CDAC
new_libraries.sentence: Library for communicating with Firebase.
new_libraries.paragraph: This library simplifies the process of communicating with Firebase. It hides the complexity of authentication and json parsing.

new_libraries.name: VEGA_IRremote
new_libraries.author: CDAC
new_libraries.sentence: Send and receive infrared signals with multiple protocols
new_libraries.paragraph:
Currently included protocols: Denon / Sharp, JVC, LG / LG2, NEC / Onkyo / Apple, Panasonic / Kaseikyo, RC5, RC6, Samsung, Sony, (Pronto), BangOlufsen, BoseWave, Lego, Whynter, FAST, MagiQuest.

New: Added FAST Protocol. Changed some function signatures. Improved handling of PULSE_DISTANCE + PULSE_WIDTH protocols.
Release notes

new_libraries.name: VEGA_MAX30100

new_libraries.name: VEGA_MAX30102

new_libraries.paragraph: This library exposes most of the features of the MAX30102 and offers a modular approach to calculate pulse rate and SpO2

new_libraries.name: VEGA_MLX90614
new_libraries.author: CDAC

new_libraries.paragraph: MLX90614 chip in GY909 Temperature sensor working on VEGA ARIES boards using GPIO Simulated I2C which supports Repeated Start.

new_libraries.name: VEGA_SH1106
new_libraries.author: CDAC

new_libraries.paragraph: This is a library for 1.3 inch XFP1116-07A Y OLED displays.

new_libraries.name: VEGA_SoftwareSerial
new_libraries.author: CDAC
new_libraries.sentence: Enables serial communication on any digital pin.
new_libraries.paragraph: The SoftwareSerial library has been developed to allow serial communication, using software to replicate the functionality of the hardware UART. It is possible to have multiple software serial ports with speeds up to 115200 bps.

new_libraries.name: VEGA_ST7735_and_ST7789
new_libraries.author: CDAC
new_libraries.sentence: This is a library for the Adafruit ST7735 and ST7789 SPI displays.
new_libraries.paragraph: This is a library for the Adafruit ST7735 and ST7789 SPI displays.

new_libraries.name: VEGA_WiFiNINA
new_libraries.author: CDAC
new_libraries.sentence: Enables network connection (local and Internet) with VEGA ARIES IoT, ARIES NOVA
new_libraries.paragraph: With this library you can instantiate Servers, Clients and send/receive UDP packets through WiFi. The board can connect either to open or encrypted networks (WEP, WPA). The IP address can be assigned statically or through a DHCP. The library can also manage DNS.

new_libraries.name: VEGA-UIP
new_libraries.author: CDAC
new_libraries.sentence: Ethernet library for Aries Alpha and Aries IOT board
new_libraries.paragraph: implements the same API as stock Ethernet-lib. Just replace the include of Ethernet.h with UIPEthernet.h

new_libraries.name: VEGAIoT_BusIO
new_libraries.author: CDAC
new_libraries.sentence: This is a library for abstracting away UART, I2C and SPI interfacing
new_libraries.paragraph: This is a library for abstracting away UART, I2C and SPI interfacing for VEGA ARIES IoT boards

new_libraries.name: VwireIOT
new_libraries.author: Vwire IOT Team <support@vwire.io>
new_libraries.sentence: Professional IoT platform library for Arduino, ESP32, ESP8266 and compatible boards
new_libraries.paragraph: Connect microcontrollers to Vwire IOT platform via MQTT. Supports TCP and TLS/SSL encrypted connections (MQTTS recommended). Features include virtual pins, OTA updates, push notifications, WiFi provisioning (AP Mode), and real-time dashboard control.

new_libraries.name: WAMR-ESP32
new_libraries.author: WAMR-ESP32-Arduino Contributors, Bytecode Alliance
new_libraries.sentence: WebAssembly Micro Runtime for ESP32/ESP32-S3
new_libraries.paragraph: Lightweight WebAssembly interpreter for running WASM modules on ESP32 and ESP32-S3. Supports fast interpreter mode with small footprint and high performance. Ideal for embedded IoT applications requiring dynamic code loading and sandboxed execution.

new_libraries.name: WCB_Client
new_libraries.author: Greg Hulette
new_libraries.sentence: Client library for joining a Wireless Communication Board (WCB) ESP-NOW network.
new_libraries.paragraph: Allows any ESP32-based device to participate as a native peer in a WCB network. Supports unicast and broadcast text commands with automatic fragmentation for long commands (e.g. saving large stored sequences), raw binary forwarding for Pololu/Maestro servo packets via WCBStream, ETM heartbeat and ACK tracking, board online/offline status callbacks, and communication with an out-of-band special peer such as NaviCore via enableSpecialPeer(). A raw-packet hook (onRawPacket/sendRawPacket) lets custom protocols — such as firmware OTA — ride the same ESP-NOW mesh.

new_libraries.name: webthing-arduino
new_libraries.author: WebThingsIO <team@webthings.io>
new_libraries.sentence: A library for creating Web Things using the Web of Things API
new_libraries.paragraph: Runs on ESP8266, ESP32, Ethernet, and WiFi101-compatible boards. Compatible with the WebThings Gateway.

new_libraries.name: WiFiController
new_libraries.author: Leandro Tavares da Silva
new_libraries.sentence: Gerenciamento avançado de WiFi para ESP8266 e ESP32.
new_libraries.paragraph: Biblioteca que fornece STA, Access Point, Captive Portal, mDNS automático, fallback AP e callbacks de eventos WiFi.

new_libraries.name: WirelessRC
new_libraries.author: Havish Vivek
new_libraries.sentence: Simple wireless RC car library using RadioHead ASK for Arduino.
new_libraries.paragraph: Drive a two-motor RC car wirelessly with a joystick controller. Includes Car (receiver) and Controller (transmitter) sides. Supports configurable motor pins, deadzone, speed, button-triggered auto-drive, and an optional SSD1306 OLED display on the controller side.

new_libraries.name: WS2812 Lib for Air001

new_libraries.paragraph: This is an Arduino library for controlling ws2812b led on Air001.

new_libraries.sentence: xxHash library for arduino (NEW V2 API).
new_libraries.paragraph: xxHash is a light, fast and cross-platform hash algorithm, this library brings  XXH32 variant support for arduino (new API from version 2), original algorithm by Yann Collet: www.xxhash.com

new_libraries.name: YuaMQTT
new_libraries.author: Edwin Kestler
new_libraries.sentence: Yet Another UART MQTT Library - MQTT 5.0 for Arduino Uno via SIM800/SIM900 GPRS.
new_libraries.paragraph: Lightweight MQTT V5.0 packet construction and parsing designed for Arduino Uno (2KB RAM). Includes SIM800 and SIM900 AT command helpers for GPRS TCP connections. Transport-agnostic core with optional module-specific helpers.

new_libraries.name: Zaber ASCII
new_libraries.author: Zaber Technologies Inc.
new_libraries.sentence: Provides helpers for interacting with Zaber devices using the Zaber ASCII protocol.
new_libraries.paragraph: This library allows for issuing commands and receiving responses to and from Zaber devices, using either the Zaber shield or other serial shields.

new_libraries.name: Zaber Binary
new_libraries.author: Alice Foster
new_libraries.sentence: Provides helpers for interacting with Zaber devices using the Zaber Binary protocol.
new_libraries.paragraph: This library allows for issuing commands and receiving responses to and from Zaber devices, using either the Zaber shield or other serial shields.

new_libraries.name: ZenoPCB
new_libraries.author: ZENOPCB ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD <infor@zenopcb.vn>
new_libraries.sentence: Declarative IoT library for ESP32, ESP8266, UNO R4 WiFi and STM32 — WiFi provisioning, MQTT, OTA, Modbus, ZSignals, alarms, schedules and irrigation.
new_libraries.paragraph: Single-entry-point library for the ZenoPCB IoT platform. v0.4.0 introduces a declarative ZSignal API: DEVICE_TO_CLOUD / CLOUD_TO_DEVICE / ZENO_EVERY macros self-register at file scope, so the setup() chain stays a single `wifi().device().begin()` line. Provides WiFi captive-portal provisioning, MQTT (with optional TLS), HTTP OTA with rollback, Modbus RTU/TCP with register-polling and MQTT control, ZSignals (Z0..Z254) custom telemetry/control, edge alarm rules, schedule execution, irrigation scenarios, and diagnostics reporting. Vendors ArduinoJson, PubSubClient, TinyGSM, Preferences, FlashStorage and StreamDebugger so a single install is enough. Optional features are gated by build flags: ZENOPCB_ENABLE_TLS, ZENOPCB_ENABLE_ETHERNET, ZENOPCB_ENABLE_CELLULAR.

new_libraries.name: ZenRTC
new_libraries.author: NexByteIO
new_libraries.sentence: Robust DS3231 RTC helper for ESP32 with OSF handling and NVS last-good time.
new_libraries.paragraph: Prevents time jumps after brownouts/weak coin cells. Auto-recovery and simple API.

library.name: 7Semi ADXL335 Accelerometer

library.name: 7Semi BME280

library.name: 7Semi BME690
library.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
library.sentence: Arduino library for the 7Semi BME690 sensor module (gas, pressure, temperature, humidity).
library.paragraph: Supports BME690 sensor over I2C and SPI. Includes functions to read gas resistance (VOC), temperature, humidity, and barometric pressure. Ideal for environmental and air quality sensing applications.

library.name: 7Semi BMI270
library.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
library.sentence: Arduino library for the Bosch BMI270 IMU (7Semi wrapper)
library.paragraph: Provides easy initialization and sensor readout for the Bosch BMI270 IMU over I2C or SPI, ideal for embedded and ESP32/Arduino projects.

library.name: 7Semi BMI323
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Lightweight and efficient BMI323 IMU sensor library.
library.paragraph: Provides a clean and high-performance interface for Bosch BMI323 6-axis IMU over I2C and SPI. Supports accelerometer and gyroscope configuration, FIFO, interrupts, calibration, and sensor data processing. Designed for embedded efficiency and ease of use.

library.name: 7Semi BMP384
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Lightweight and efficient BMP384 pressure and temperature sensor library.
library.paragraph: Provides a clean, high-performance interface for Bosch BMP384 sensors over I2C and SPI. Includes support for FIFO, interrupts, filtering, oversampling, and altitude calculation. Designed for embedded efficiency and ease of use.

library.name: 7Semi BMP58x
library.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
library.sentence: Lightweight BMP58x driver for Arduino (I2C/SPI) with beginner-friendly defaults.
library.paragraph: Arduino library for the Bosch Sensortec BMP58x barometric pressure sensor. Supports I2C and SPI on Arduino-core boards (ESP32/AVR/STM32/RP2040 etc). Includes safe default configuration via initSensor() so the sensor works out-of-box, plus helpers for OSR/ODR/IIR, interrupts, FIFO, OOR window, and NVM access. Optional I2C/SPI pin mapping is supported on ESP32 cores.

library.name: 7Semi BMV080
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Arduino library for accurate particulate matter sensing using Bosch Sensortec BMV080
library.paragraph: Arduino wrapper around the official Bosch Sensortec BMV080 SDK. Users must provide Bosch SDK header and library files.

library.name: 7Semi BNO08x
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Minimal BNO08x IMU SHTP driver with pluggable I2C/SPI/UART transports.
library.paragraph: Provides a compact BNO08x (BNO080/BNO085/BNO086) driver focused on parsing sensor reports over the SH-2 Transport Protocol (SHTP). Includes transport adapters for I2C, SPI, and UART HDLC-style framing, plus simple feature-enable helpers and cached sensor getters.

library.name: 7Semi DAC7578
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Arduino driver for Texas Instruments DAC7578 8-channel 12-bit I2C DAC.
library.paragraph: Lightweight production-grade driver for the TI DAC7578. Supports voltage and raw DAC writes, synchronous channel updates, LDAC register control, clear code register, and power-down modes. Includes internal channel caching for fast readback.

library.name: 7Semi ENS210
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: ENS210 temperature and humidity sensor library for Arduino.
library.paragraph: High-accuracy ENS210 temperature and humidity sensor library with CRC validation, single-shot and continuous modes, and Kelvin/Celsius/Fahrenheit/Absolute humidity calculations. Optimized for ESP32, AVR, and other Arduino-compatible platforms.

library.name: 7Semi HMC6343 Compass
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Arduino library for the HMC6343 3-axis digital compass sensor with tilt compensation.
library.paragraph: This library allows interfacing with the HMC6343 sensor over I2C to read heading, pitch, roll, magnetometer, accelerometer, and temperature values. It also supports calibration and configuration options, making it ideal for robotics, navigation, and embedded systems.

library.name: 7Semi ICM20948
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Arduino library for the 7Semi ICM-20948 9-axis IMU (Accel, Gyro, Mag, Temp).
library.paragraph: Supports both I2C and SPI communication, configurable DLPF, full-scale range, output data rate, and magnetometer access via internal I2C master. Includes clean example sketches for ESP32 and Arduino UNO.

library.name: 7Semi INA260
library.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
library.sentence: Arduino library for the INA260 current, power, and bus voltage monitor over I2C.
library.paragraph: Provides easy APIs to read current (mA), power (mW), and bus voltage (mV) from the INA260 with configurable averaging and conversion times. Includes example sketches.

library.name: 7Semi LIS3DH
library.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
library.sentence: Arduino library for LIS3DH 3-axis accelerometer with I2C and SPI support.
library.paragraph: This library supports LIS3DH accelerometer over I2C and SPI with features like raw and g-unit acceleration, INT1/INT2 interrupts, ADC readings, and temperature measurement.

library.name: 7Semi MAX31855
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: MAX31855 thermocouple interface library for Arduino and ESP32.
library.paragraph: High-quality SPI driver for MAX31855 thermocouple-to-digital converter. Supports temperature reading in Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin. Includes fault detection and cold junction monitoring. Designed for Arduino, ESP32, and STM32 platforms.

library.name: 7Semi MLX90393
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: MLX90393 3-axis magnetometer library
library.paragraph: Lightweight and configurable Arduino library for the MLX90393 sensor. Supports magnetic field measurement (µT), configurable gain, resolution, OSR, filter, and ESP32 custom I2C pins.

library.name: 7Semi SHT4x
library.author: 7Semi <info@7semi.com>
library.sentence: Arduino library for the 7Semi SHT4x (SHT40/SHT41/SHT45) temperature and humidity sensor.
library.paragraph: Supports I2C communication for precise humidity and temperature data using SHT4x series sensors. Ideal for IoT and environmental sensing.

library.name: 7Semi STS3x
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Arduino library for the Sensirion STS3x digital temperature sensor.
library.paragraph: Provides an easy-to-use interface for the Sensirion STS3x temperature sensor over I2C. Supports single-shot and periodic measurements with CRC validation and configurable repeatability levels.

library.name: 7Semi STS4x
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Arduino library for Sensirion STS4x digital temperature sensors over I2C.
library.paragraph: Lightweight and easy-to-use Arduino library for Sensirion STS4x temperature sensors. Supports single-shot measurements, CRC validation for data integrity, configurable repeatability (precision levels), and optional smoothing filter. Designed for Arduino, ESP32, and other I2C-compatible platforms.

library.name: 7Semi TMP11x
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Arduino library for Texas Instruments TMP116/TMP117 high-accuracy temperature sensors.
library.paragraph: Supports TMP116 and TMP117 via I2C with temperature in C/F, configuration (conversion rate, averaging, modes), alert/therm settings, alert polarity, limits, offset, and EEPROM access. Compatible with Arduino, ESP32, and ESP8266.

library.name: 7Semi TMP23x
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Arduino library for Texas Instruments TMP23x analog temperature sensors.
library.paragraph: Supports TMP235 and TMP236 analog temperature sensors with accurate voltage-to-temperature conversion, ADC abstraction, averaging, smoothing, and calibration features. Compatible with Arduino, ESP32, and ESP8266.

library.name: 7Semi VEML7700
library.author: 7Semi
library.sentence: Arduino library for the VEML7700 ambient light sensor.
library.paragraph: This library provides an easy interface for the Vishay VEML7700 ambient light sensor. It supports lux measurement, white channel reading, interrupt configuration, power saving modes, and automatic gain/integration adjustment for accurate measurements across a wide light range.

library.name: 7Semi_ADS1xx5
library.author: 7semi <info@7semi.com>
library.sentence: Arduino library for Texas Instruments ADS1015 and ADS1115 16-bit ADC with I2C interface.
library.paragraph: This library allows easy access to all features of the ADS1015 and ADS1115 including single-ended and differential voltage readings, comparator threshold settings, and PGA gain selection. Supports both single-shot and continuous conversion modes.

It will also generate an arbitrary FSQ message of up to 200 characters in both directed and non-directed format. When paired with a synthesizer that can output frequencies in fine, phase-continuous tuning steps (such as the Si5351), then a beacon or telemetry transmitter can be created which can change the transmitted characters as needed from the Arduino.

library.name: Itty Bitty
library.author: Tom Biuso <tjbtech@yahoo.com>
library.sentence:
With the fastest possible Arduino-compatible GPIO and register manipulation...
It's the biggest of hits when you need to bang bits!
library.paragraph:
Getting tired of mindlessly staring down your wristwatch in an open-mouthed gape, awaiting a digitalRead's return? Do you long for a super-simple way to set or flip your bits? Has repeatedly ALT-TABing to the ATmega datasheets to look up register descriptions worn you down to the last raw nerve?

Then, golly gee, this lib is here to allay your despair!

In fact, it was made for you - whether an Arduino n00b, hopelessly ignorant to the time their programs waste on the simplest IO tasks, or an AVR guru and uber-smart embedded god, who never even gave a thought to seeking an easier way to bang bits. Most of all, however, this library is for the wretched, cursed signals stuck in the maze of your Arduino's buffers. For it is they who fly through pin lines at the speed of light only to quietly suffer the most indignant fate at the hands of non-performant source code: WAITING.

So set those bits free with a little help from your friends - a plenitude of easy-to-use functions, macros, and data structures in this simple, elegant library that will give your code real legs. But, more importantly, it makes coding that much more FUNNER.

library.name: MG811SpaceData

library.sentence: The first and only Arduino library where MG811 Gas Sensor combine with Data Science
library.paragraph: This library calculates the ppm values of CO2, C2H5OH, CO, CH4 (the primary gases), and Theoretical CO2 using analog data obtained from the MG811 gas sensor. Concentrations of the primary gases are determined by applying the cathodic reaction correction coefficient over 20-second intervals, along with the effects of temperature and humidity on the a and b parameters of the ppm values. Theoretical CO2, on the other hand, is derived from a polynomial curve created based on the Nernst equation. Additionally, the library supports Python-based data science applications, including 4D ppm concentration graph simulations at 20-second intervals and a 4D ppm slope estimation platform for advanced data analysis.

When the PIR sensor detects a presence - meaning it detects the heat generated by a warm body within it's range, it will set the output "open" - so if you have a pull-up resistor, the waveform will be at 0v when nothing is detected and 3.3v when something is detected.

One EspBridge.begin() call starts a FreeRTOS task model (separate TX, RX and network tasks) so blocking radio I/O never stalls peripheral traffic. Requires arduino-esp32 core 3.x. Also runs on the Nordic nRF52840 (Seeed XIAO / Adafruit Bluefruit core) with a capability-gated subset: BLE link, GPIO, ADC, PWM and I2C.

library.sentence: Hydruino: Simple automation controller for hydroponic grow systems.
library.paragraph: Allows one to set up a system of reservoirs, pumps, probes, relays, and other objects useful in automating the daily lighting, feed dosing, watering, and data monitoring & collection processes involved in hydroponically grown fruits, vegetables, teas, herbs, and salves. Works with a large variety of widely-available aquarium/hobbyist equipment, including popular GPS, RTC, EEPROM, SD card, WiFi, and other modules compatible with Arduino. Contains a large library of crop data to select from that will automatically aim the system for the best growing parameters during the various growth phases for the system configured, along with fully customizable weekly feed/additive amounts and daily feeding/lighting scheduling. With the right setup Hydruino can automatically do things like: enable grow lights for the needed period each day, drive water pumps and auto-dosers during feedings, spray leafy plants in the morning before lights/sunrise, heat cold water to a specific temp for tropical plants, use CO2 sensors to manage air circulation fans to maintain optimal grow tent parameters, or even use soil moisture sensing to dynamically determine watering schedule.

Works with a large variety of widely-available aquarium/hobbyist equipment, including popular GPS, RTC, EEPROM, SD card, WiFi, and other modules compatible with Arduino. Can be setup to calculate sun position accurately as possible or to auto-balance two opposing photoresistors per panel axis. With the right setup Helioduino can automatically do things like: drive large panels with linear actuators, use power sensing to auto-optimize daily panel offset, spray/wipe panels on routine to keep panels clean, deploy/retract panels at sunrise/sunset, or even provide panel heating during cold temperatures or when ice is detected.

library.paragraph:
The HTS221 is an ultra compact sensor for relative humidity and temperature.
It includes a sensing element and a mixed signal ASIC to provide the measurement information through digital serial interfaces.
The sensing element consists of a polymer dielectric planar capacitor structure capable of detecting relative humidity variations and is manufactured using a dedicated ST process.
The HTS221 is available in a small top-holed cap land grid array (HLGA) package guaranteed to operate over a temperature range from -40 °C to +120 °C.

It includes a monolithic sensing element and an IC interface able to take the information from the sensing element and to provide a digital signal to the external world.

The sensing element consists of a suspended membrane realized inside a single mono-silicon substrate.
It is capable to detect the absolute pressure and is manufactured with a dedicated process developed by ST.

The LSM6DS3 is a system-in-package featuring a 3D digital linear acceleration sensor, a 3D digital angular rate sensor.
The LSM6DS3 has a linear acceleration full scale of ±2g/±4g/±8/±16 g, a magnetic field full scale of ±4/±8/±12/±16 gauss and an angular rate of ±245/±500/±2000 dps.
The LSM6DS3 includes an I2C serial bus interface supporting standard and fast mode (100 kHz and 400 kHz) and an SPI serial standard interface.
Accelerometer and gyroscope sensing can be enabled or set in power-down mode separately for smart power management.

The LSM9DS1 has a linear acceleration full scale of ±2g/±4g/±8/±16 g, a magnetic field full scale of ±4/±8/±12/±16 gauss and an angular rate of ±245/±500/±2000 dps.
The LSM9DS1 includes an I2C serial bus interface supporting standard and fast mode (100 kHz and 400 kHz) and an SPI serial standard interface.
Magnetic, accelerometer and gyroscope sensing can be enabled or set in power-down mode separately for smart power management.

It has high value technical characteristics such as a -126dBm sensitivity, ultra-low power consumption and up to 15.5dBm of Output power.

Use with Qwiic EEPROM to make it easy to read and write cal data and other user settings. Configurable I2C buffer size increases throughput up to 30kB/s. Includes examples demonstrating wear-level writing, SD file to EEPROM write, and auto writes/verifies to EEPROM. Tested with 24LC00, 24LC01B, 24AA02, 24LC04B, 24LC16BH, 24LC32A, 24LC256, CAT24C512, 24LC1025, and 24LC1026.

There is also an additional register to check if the button had been pressed since the last read of the button register. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/15168

library.name: SparkFun Qwiic Keypad Arduino Library
library.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
library.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic Keypad
library.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the Qwiic Keypad. Qwiic Keypad makes reading a 12 button keypad over I2C easy and fast. The button and the time since it was pressed can be read from separate registers. It actually records up to 15 button presses (and their timestamps) to a stack, which can be read in sequence from oldest to newest. It will overflow and continue to remember the most recent 15 presses. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/14836

library.name: SparkFun Qwiic LED Stick Library
library.author: SparkFun Electronics
library.sentence: Library for the SparkFun Qwiic LED Stick
library.paragraph: The Qwiic LED Stick features ten addressable APA102 LEDs, making it easy to add an output to your latest project. Write to individual LEDs to display a count in binary, or write to the whole strip for cool lighting effects.

library.name: SparkFun Qwiic MP3 Trigger Arduino Library
library.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>

library.paragraph: An Arduino Library for the Qwist MP3 Trigger. Qwiic MP3 Trigger is an easy to use MP3 player that makes loading and playing MP3s easy and fast. Play, pause, stop, volume, and EQ are all digitally controlled over I2C . Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/15165

Static resources are loaded once, and only on explicit declaration. This library supports the SparkFun Qwiic Micro OLED, 0.91in OLED, Transparent Graphical OLED, smôl OLED Display, and any other board using the SSD1306 IC.

library.paragraph: This library allows the user to see if there is currently an object detected in front of the SparkFun PIR (EKMC4607112K/EKMB1107112) as well as allows for reading of detection events from a buffer.

library.name: SparkFun Qwiic Power Switch Arduino Library

library.name: SparkFun Qwiic Relay Arduino Library

library.paragraph: The SparkFun Qwiic Relay Arduino Library makes it very easy to use the Qwiic enabled relays from SparkFun Electronics. It gives you easy to use functions to turn on and off relays, toggle them, and check their status. Also provided is example code for each board ( and the ) that gives instructions on how to use the library to its fullest.

library.paragraph: The SparkFun Qwiic RFID Arduino Library makes it very easy to use the Qwiic enabled I-squared-C RFID reader from SparkFun Electronics. The SparkFun Qwiic RFID Reader can hold up to 20 scanned RFID tags and their associated scan times at a time. The library gives easy to use functions that allow you to get a scanned tag, get the tag's scan time, or get all 20 available tags and their scan times at once. Also provided is example code to demonstrate each available function.

library.name: SparkFun Qwiic RTC RV1805 Arduino Library
library.author: Andy England, Nathan Seidle
library.sentence: A library to drive the RV-1805 extremely precise, extremely low power, real-time clock
library.paragraph: The RV-1805-C3 from SparkFun is a very unique and exciting Real Time Clock. It is extremely precise (less than 7ppm per year!), extremely low power (less than 22nA!) and has all the necessary oscillators built-in making it small! The RV-1805 has not one, but two internal oscillators: a 32.768kHz tuning fork crystal and a lower power RC based oscillator. The RV-1805 can be configured to automatically switch between oscillators using the more precise crystal to correct the RC oscillator every few minutes. This allows the RTC to maintain a very accurate date and time with the worst case being +/- about 3 minutes over a year. The RV-1805 library operates the RTC at 22nA allowing for very long run times with very small backup power sources.

library.name: SparkFun Qwiic RTC RV8803 Arduino Library
library.author: SparkFun Electronics <sparkfun.com>
library.sentence: A library to drive the RV-8803 extremely precise, extremely low power, real-time clock
library.paragraph: The RV-8803 from SparkFun is an extraordinarily precise, temperature-compensated RTC. The module itself can run as low as 240 nA. This library allows you to set and get time, set the hundredths registers, configure interrupts, and even calibrate your RTC.

library.name: SparkFun Qwiic Scale NAU7802 Arduino Library
library.author: SparkFun Electronics

library.paragraph: The Qwiic Scale from SparkFun is based on the NAU7802. This IC is a I2C controlled 24-bit ADC capable of converting load cells into a digital signal. The SparkFun Qwiic Scale board makes it easy to create a digital scale without soldering. Checkout the Qwiic Scale for more information.

library.name: SparkFun Qwiic Step Arduino Library

library.sentence: Control one or more stepper motors by sending I2C commands over the easy-to-use Qwiic system to your SparkFun Qwiic Step Board.
library.paragraph: Qwiic Step makes stepper motors very easy to control. This library handles all the I2C commands needed to run a motor continuously or to a given position, with constant speed or acceleration, or change microstep modes. We've built-in added features such as reading interrupts, setting up an emergency stop, or running headless for further customizability to your system.

library.name: SparkFun Qwiic TMF-8801 Time-of-flight Library

TMF-8801 uses infrared laser light, SPAD, TDC and histogram technology to measure distances up to 98.4 inches (2500 mm). This device meets Class 1 laser safety limits including single faults in compliance with IEC / EN 60825-1:2014.

library.name: SparkFun Qwiic TMF882X Library
library.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>

library.paragraph: The TMF882X is the latest Time Of Flight (ToF) sensor to be released from AMS. It uses a SPAD (Single Photon Avalanche Photodiode) histogram architecture to accurately detect objects from 10mm all the way to 5000 mm. That’s millimeter accuracy, with a range of 1 centimeter to 5 meters – amazing! Oh, and these sensors are multi-zone – supporting 3x3, 4x4 and 3x6 zones of operation depending on which model is being used. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/19036, https://www.sparkfun.com/products/19451

The two large, exposed pads function as probes for the sensor, together acting as a variable resistor. The more water that is in the soil means the better the conductivity between the pads will be and will result in a lower resistance, and a higher SIG out. This version of the Soil Moisture Sensor includes a Qwiic connector, making it even easier to use this sensor.

An Arduino Library to enable both I2C and Serial communication for both NMEA reception and binary UBX sending to u-blox modules. Useful for interfacing to the SparkFun GPS-RTK2 ZED-F9P, SparkFun GPS-RTK NEO-M8P-2, the SparkFun SAM-M8Q, and the SparkFun ZOE-M8Q. Library also works with other u-blox based boards.

The ZED-F9P and NEO-M8P-2 modules are top-of-the-line modules for high accuracy GNSS and GPS location solutions including RTK. The ZED-F9P is unique in that it is capable of both rover and base station operations allowing the module to become a base station and produce RTCM 3.x correction data.

library.paragraph:
An Arduino library for the u-blox SARA-R5 LTE-M / NB-IoT modules with secure cloud, as used on the SparkFun MicroMod Asset Tracker and the SparkFun LTE GNSS Breakout - SARA-R5.

v1.1 has had a thorough update and includes new features and examples. This library now supports up to 7 simultaneous TCP or UDP sockets. There are new examples to show how to play ping pong with both TCP and UDP sockets.

v1.1 also supports binary data transfers correctly. There are new examples showing how you can integrate this library with the SparkFun u-blox GNSS Arduino Library, to use the SARA-R5 to: download AssistNow Online and Offline data and push it to the GNSS; open a connection to a NTRIP Caster (such as RTK2go, Skylark or Emlid Caster) and push RTK correction data to the GNSS.

Other receivers in the same family should work: UM982, UM960, UM960L, etc. The UM980 is a 1408-Channel GNSS Receiver based on the Nebulas IV™ that is able to simultaneously track GPS L1/L2/L5, GLONASS L1/L2/L3, Galileo E1/E5a/E5b/E6, Beidou B1I/B2I/B3I/B1C/B2a/B2b, QZSS L1/L2/L5, and SBAS. library.name: SparkFun VCNL4040 Proximity Sensor Library

library.paragraph: The VCNL4040 is a simple IR presence and ambient light sensor. This sensor is excellent for detecting if something has appeared in front of the sensor. We often see this type of sensor on automatic towel dispensers, automatic faucets, etc. You can detect objects qualitatively up to 20cm away. This means you can detect if something is there, and if it is closer or further away since the last reading, but it's difficult to say it is 7.2cm away. If you need quantitative distance readings (for example sensing that an object is 177mm away) check out the SparkFun Time of Flight (ToF) sensors with mm accuracy.

library.name: SparkFun VEML7700 Arduino Library
library.author: SparkFun Electronics <techsupport@sparkfun.com>
library.sentence: Library for the VEML7700 Ambient Light Sensor

The SparkFun Qwiic VEML7700 Ambient Light Sensor provides accurate, 16-bit ambient light readings from 0 to 167,000 lux via the I2C interface. This miniature sensor (6.8mm x 3.0mm x 2.5mm) features a high-sensitivity photodiode, a low-noise amplifier, and a 16-bit analog-to-digital (A/D) converter. Its unshifted 7-bit I2C address is 0x10. library.paragraph: The VL53L1X is the latest Time Of Flight (ToF) sensor to be released. It uses a VCSEL (vertical cavity surface emitting laser) to emit a class 1 IR laser and time the reflection to the target. What does all this mean? You can measure the distance to an object up to 4 meters away with millimeter resolution! That’s pretty incredible. We’ve found the precision of the sensor to be 1mm but the accuracy is around +/-5mm. Available at: https://www.sparkfun.com/products/14667
